exposure: Patients with placenta accreta spectrum undergoing obstetric hysterectomy
Double uterine segment tourniquet use during hysterectomy
Use of double uterine segment tourniquet (yes vs no)
cohort: 80 patients with placenta accreta spectrum who underwent obstetric hysterectomy (40 in the tourniquet group and 40 in the non-tourniquet group).
finding: The use of a double uterine segment tourniquet during obstetric hysterectomy for placenta accreta spectrum was associated with lower blood loss, lower hemoglobin drop, and reduced blood transfusion requirements without affecting surgical time or urinary tract lesions.
